blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No ticket won the jackpots in the Ultra Lotto 6/58 and Mega Lotto 6/45 draws Friday, Sept. 18, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). The Ultra Lotto 6/58 winning combination was 07-51-39-30-49-02 for a jackpot of ₱307.76 million. PCSO said there was no jackpot winner. The Mega Lotto 6/45 winning combination was 24-09-04-01-40-14 for a jackpot of ₱63.44 million. No ticket matched all six numbers.
